terms.comment: Greek ἄγγελος, a messenger. A guardian angel: Comenius says God gives each person angels from birth ut custōdēs (Orbis pictus 149).

phrases.latin: Quoniam angelīs suīs mandāvit dē tē, ut custōdiant tē in omnibus viīs tuīs.
phrases.english: For he has given his angels charge of you, to keep you in all your ways.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. angel.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-vulgata, loci-comenius), checked against the editions named there.
